newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus nine month sales up 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus nine month sales up 10.8 pct.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)

NOTE - Canal Plus, Europe's largest pay television network, said subscription revenue rose by 9.7 percent, led by the good marketing performance of Canal Plus and Canalsatellite in France. The French channel reported revenues of 6.19 billion francs for the period while the introduction of digital direct-to-home service powered a 34 percent increase in Canalsatellite's revenues to 442 million francs.

Revenues from other goods and services mainly includes the revenue of production and distribution subsidiaries. Studio Canal Plus had revenues of 315 million francs versus 321 million. Elipse Programme had revenues of 336 million versus 224 million in 1995 and Canal Plus DA had revenues of 74 million versus 39 million. The figures also include for the first time the revenues of UGC DA which has been consolidated since July 1. UGC DA reported 67 million francs in revenues for the third quarter. Excluding UGC DA, consolidated revenues for the Canal Plus Group would have risen by 9.9 percent over the period.
